name_de: Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE22 Pro 800 FE
name_en: Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE22 Pro 800 FE
description_de: Das Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE22 Pro 800 FE ist ein vollgefedertes E-Mountainbike von Cube. Der Antrieb (Bosch Performance Line CX) mit bis zu 120 Nm Drehmoment wird von einem 800-Wh-Akku gespeist. Federung: SR Suntour XCR36X 2CR Air, Tapered, 15x110mm, 120mm · Dämpfer SR Suntour EdgeX R 185x52.5mm, Rebound Adjust, Trunnion Mount. Schaltung: Shimano Deore RD-M6200-SGS, ShadowPlus, 12-Speed. Bremsen: Shimano BR-MT420, Hydr. Disc Brake (203/203). Rahmen: Aluminium Superlite. Erhältlich in den Größen S, M, L, XL.
description_en: The Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE22 Pro 800 FE is a full-suspension electric mountain bike from Cube. The drive (Bosch Performance Line CX) with up to 120 Nm of torque is powered by an 800 Wh battery. Suspension: SR Suntour XCR36X 2CR Air, Tapered, 15x110mm, 120mm · Dämpfer SR Suntour EdgeX R 185x52.5mm, Rebound Adjust, Trunnion Mount. Drivetrain: Shimano Deore RD-M6200-SGS, ShadowPlus, 12-Speed. Brakes: Shimano BR-MT420, Hydr. Disc Brake (203/203). Frame: Aluminium Superlite. Available in sizes S, M, L, XL.
